f649b4202a7f108948068527aaf137ebea7e10d1.summary: A Medium post by Michael Koczwara, published 2021-09-15, maps Cobalt Strike command-and-control infrastructure that is possibly attributed to CVE-2021-40444. The author starts from a TrendMicro blog and checks whether the threat actor used other C2 servers on the same hosting provider, subnets and IP ranges. The post names no threat actor, sector, or country.

f60783926da05ba81e9780327e6a2596bbf6760f.summary: PRODAFT and INVICTUS Threat Intelligence (PTI) published this report on 1 September 2020 about BadUSB attacks by the Fin7 group. Fin7 used USB drives modified to act as keyboards to run PowerShell, and a Bella remote administration tool against macOS victims. The report describes antivirus test results gathered by attackers that its team did not validate. It counts 325 victims in 16 countries, mostly in the USA, with bot notifications observed from February to April 2020.
